datasets.name: Pre- and postlandslide aerial photographs of Cloudy Hill, Hong Kong

methods.name: CDMI-Net
methods.summary: A neural network for landslide mapping that combines a two-stream U-Net with shared weights for deep feature extraction (change detection) and a multiple-instance learning (MIL) framework with a gated attention-based pooling layer to identify landslide pixels from scene-level labels, followed by a fast level-set evolution algorithm for boundary refinement.
methods.source: Min Zhang, Wenzhong Shi, Shanxiong Chen, Zhao Zhan, and Zhicheng Shi
methods.verbatim: Its implementation code is freely available1. ... 1https://github.com/MinZHANG-WHU/CDMI-Net

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory dataset is not referenced or linked. The custom code for CDMI-Net is available via a provided GitHub repository link.
